about.title: About Bitcoin Calculator
about.description: The Bitcoin Calculator is a cryptocurrency planning tool that helps you estimate Bitcoin investment returns, track portfolio performance, and compare crypto scenarios. This calculator uses current Bitcoin price data, historical performance references, and projection inputs to help you review possible outcomes. Whether you're exploring cryptocurrency or tracking existing holdings, this tool offers planning reference points for Bitcoin scenarios.

faq.q: How is Bitcoin investment return calculated?
faq.a: Bitcoin returns are calculated based on the difference between your purchase price and current/target price, divided by your initial investment. The calculator uses current Bitcoin prices and historical data for estimated return calculations.

faq.q: What is dollar-cost averaging for Bitcoin?
faq.a: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA) involves making regular Bitcoin purchases regardless of price. This strategy helps reduce the impact of volatility by spreading purchases over time, potentially lowering your average cost per Bitcoin.

Bitcoin is highly volatile and speculative. This calculator is for general planning reference rather than individualized guidance. Review your risk tolerance, time horizon, and overall portfolio mix before making decisions.

faq.q: How do I track Bitcoin for taxes?
faq.a: Keep detailed records of all Bitcoin transactions including purchase dates, amounts, and prices. Bitcoin is treated as property by the IRS, so you'll need to report capital gains/losses when you sell or exchange Bitcoin.
